blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Text-in-image translation aims to translate all textual content embedded in an image. In Text Image Translation (TIT), the output is translated text; In-Image Machine Translation (IIMT) additionally renders the translation back into the image. We introduce ImgMT, a massively multilingual dataset and benchmark mined from localized SVG illustrations on Wikimedia Commons, focusing on diagrams, maps, and infographics. ImgMT contains 35,612 aligned image pairs grouped into 1,855 image sets, spanning 129 languages, 20+ writing systems, and 4,886 language pairs.
  We propose a multi-level evaluation protocol that measures source-side text-region detection and OCR accuracy alongside target-side translation quality. We benchmark several multimodal large language models and a dedicated TIT system in English->X and X->English settings, and find that the source language and writing system substantially affect TIT quality. Finally, we show that ImgMT is not well suited for isolating the contribution of visual information in multimodal translation.
blocks.zh:
图像中文本翻译旨在将嵌入图像中的所有文本内容进行翻译. 在"文本图像翻译"(Text Image Transfer (TIT))中,输出是被翻译出文本;"In-Image Machine Transfer (IIMT)"(又将翻译回成图像). 我们引入了ImgMT, 是一个大规模多语言的数据集和基准, ImgMT包含35,612个对齐的图像对被组合成1,855个图像组,跨越了129个语言,20+写作系统,以及4,886个语言对.
我们提出了一个多层次的评价协议,以衡量源侧文本区域检测和OCR准确性以及目标侧翻译质量。 我们以英文->X和X->英文设置中的若干多式大型语言模型和专用TIT系统为基准,发现源语言和写作系统对TIT质量有重大影响。 最后,我们表明,IMgMT不适于孤立视觉信息在多式联运中的贡献。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Modern multimodal models can translate from text, images, or both.
A family of text-in-image translation tasks takes an image as input and aims to translate all textual elements appearing within it.
This setting includes Text Image Translation (TIT), which outputs translated text (optionally with bounding boxes), and In-Image Machine Translation (IIMT), which further renders the translated text back into the image.
By contrast, in Multimodal Machine Translation (MMT), the source is text and the image is used only as auxiliary context.
blocks.zh:
现代多模式模型可以从文本,图像中翻译出,或者两者兼而有之.
一组成像文本翻译任务将一个图像作为输入,旨在翻译其中出现的所有文本元素.
这种设置包括文本图像翻译(TIT),它输出翻译文本(可选带边框),以及In-Image Machine翻译(IIMT),它进一步使被翻译的文本返回到图像中.
相形之下,在"多式机器翻译"(MMT)中,出处为文本,而图像仅用作辅助上下文.

blocks.en: Several datasets for text-in-image translation already exist ( Ma et al., 2022 ; Lan et al., 2023 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ; Vaidya et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) , but they share a key limitation: limited language coverage. Even the most multilingual resources typically include only 14–16 languages ( Li et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Consequently, existing benchmarks do not sufficiently stress-test systems’ multilingual capabilities, either in translating across a wide range of languages or in recognizing text written in diverse scripts.
blocks.zh: 已经有多个用于图像中文本翻译的数据集(Ma等,2022;Lan等,2023;Qian等,2024;Lyu等,2025;Vaidya等,2025;Wu等,2026),但它们具有关键限制:语言覆盖范围有限。 即使最多语言的资源通常也只包括14至16种语言(Li等,2025;Li等,2026)。 因此,现有基准没有足够的压力测试系统多语种能力,既不能翻译多种语文,也不能识别不同文字所写的文字。

blocks.en: Wikipedia has served as a rich source of multilingual supervision for multimodal tasks ( Srinivasan et al., 2021 , e.g.,) . For vision-language tasks, a particularly appealing property is that many Wikipedia illustrations are localized: the same visual is available with labels translated into dozens of languages. Since these illustrations are often stored as SVGs, where text is encoded separately from the graphical elements, they can be mined to create aligned multilingual resources for text-in-image translation.
blocks.zh: 维基百科成为多语种监督多式联运任务的丰富来源(斯里尼瓦桑等,2021等). 对于视觉语言任务,一个特别有吸引力的属性是,许多维基百科插图是本地化的:同样的视觉有被翻译成数十种语言的标签. 由于这些插图经常被存储为SVG,文本与图形元素分开编码,因此可以被挖掘以创建对齐的多语种资源来进行文本成像翻译.

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce ImgMT , a dataset and evaluation framework for assessing methods for text-in-image translation. ImgMT contains 35,612 aligned image pairs grouped into 1,855 sets of visually distinct SVG images extracted from Wikimedia Commons. The embedded text spans 129 languages, covering more than 20 writing systems (as illustrated in Figure 1 ), and yields 4,886 distinct language pairs.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了ImgMT,这是一个用于评估图像文本翻译方法的数据集和评价框架。 ImgMT包含35,612个对齐的图像对,组合成1,855组从Wikimedia Commons中提取的可视化的SVG图像. 嵌入式文本跨越129种语言,涵盖20多个书写系统(如图1所示),并产生4,886个不同的语言对.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Text Image Translation evaluation diagram.
blocks.zh: 图2:文本图像翻译评价图.

blocks.en:
ImgMT targets diagrams, maps, and infographics—content typically created as vector graphics. In contrast to scene text translation ( Lan et al., 2023 ; Qian et al., 2024 ; Vaidya et al., 2025 ) , where robustness to distorted or occluded text is often the primary challenge, our setting is dominated by translation-specific difficulties.
Unlike document image translation ( Liang et al., 2024 ) , where translated passages can be substantially longer, the text snippets in ImgMT are often short and information-dense, and they frequently include specialized terminology and named entities from scientific and educational domains.
blocks.zh:
ImgMT 目标图、地图和图像——内容通常作为矢量图形创建。 与场景文本翻译形成对比(Lan等,2023;Qian等,2024;Vaidya等,2025.),其强力扭曲或被占用的文本往往是主要挑战,而我们的设定则以翻译特有的困难为主.
与文档图像翻译(梁等,2024年)不同的是,翻译的段落可以长得多,ImgMT中的文本片段往往很短,信息敏锐,经常包括从科学和教育领域获得的专门名词和被命名的实体.

blocks.en:
Along with the dataset, we release an evaluation framework.
As shown in Figure 2 , it evaluates system outputs on both the source and target sides: on the source side, it measures text-region detection and OCR accuracy; on the target side, it scores translations using standard MT metrics.
blocks.zh:
与数据集一起,我们公布一个评价框架。
如图2所示,它评价了源面和目标面的系统输出:在源面,它测量文本区域检测和OCR精度;在目标面,它使用标准的MT度量衡来评分翻译.

blocks.en:
To demonstrate our evaluation framework in practice, we use it to benchmark multiple TIT systems, most of which are general-purpose vision--language models (VLMs). 1 1 1 The framework also supports IIMT evaluation, but we leave it for future work. We evaluate their ability to translate from English into a wide range of target languages.
In addition, we benchmark one system on translation into English to study how different source-side writing systems affect performance.
blocks.zh:
为了在实践中展示我们的评价框架,我们用它来衡量多个TIT系统,其中大部分是通用视觉语言模型(VLMs). 1个 1 该框架还支持综合管理评价,但我们将其留给今后的工作。 我们评价他们从英语翻译成多种目标语言的能力。
此外,我们将一个系统作为英文翻译的基准,研究不同源侧写作系统如何影响业绩。

blocks.en: Beyond evaluating TIT systems, we ask whether ImgMT is also useful for evaluating multimodal machine translation, specifically for quantifying the contribution of the visual modality to translation quality. In many infographics, the extracted text is sufficiently self-contained to translate correctly on its own, especially when the system is given all text at once. Therefore, any improvement from providing the image may reflect either genuine visual grounding (e.g. resolving polysemy, units, or abbreviations using surrounding graphics) or incidental cues such as layout and line segmentation. To tease these factors apart, we compare translations produced with (i) the full source image, (ii) a text-only rendering that preserves layout while removing graphical content, and (iii) plain text input without any image.
blocks.zh: 除了评价TIT系统外,我们问IMgMT是否还有助于评价多模式机器翻译,特别是用于量化视觉模式对翻译质量的贡献。 在许多图文中,取出的案文足够自成一体,可以自行正确翻译,特别是当系统同时得到所有文本时. 因此,在提供图像方面的任何改进都可能反映真实的视觉地平面(例如利用周边图形解析多聚体、单位或缩略语)或附带提示,例如布局和线段分化。 为了将这些因素区分开来,我们比较了所制作的翻译与(一) 完整的源图像,(二) 保留布局并同时去除图形内容的文本唯一渲染,(三) 没有任何图像的纯文本输入。

blocks.en: The ImgMT dataset and evaluation framework are publicly available. 2 2 2 Released simultaneously on Hugging Face ( https://huggingface.co/datasets/sarkau/ImgMT-Dataset-For-Evaluating-Text-Image-Translation ) and in the LINDAT/CLARIAH-CZ repository ( http://hdl.handle.net/11234/1-6251 ). We also provide a development repository 3 3 3 https://github.com/ufal/imgmt-devel with supplementary scripts and intermediate artifacts produced during this work.
blocks.zh: ImgMT数据集和评价框架已公开提供。 2 2 同时在Hugging Face(https://huggingface.co/datasets/sarkau/ImgMT-Dataset-For-Evaluation-Text-Image-Translation)和LINDAT/CLARIAH-CZ仓库(https://hdl.handle.net/11234/1-6251)上发布,我们还提供了开发存放处 3 3 https://github.com/ufal/imgmt-devel,配有本作期间制作的补充脚本和中间文物。

blocks.en:
The remainder of the paper is organized as follows.
We first situate ImgMT in the context of related work ( Section 2 ). We then introduce the dataset ( Section 3 ) and describe our evaluation protocol ( Section 4 ). Next, we detail our experimental setup and how we use ImgMT to benchmark TIT approaches ( Section 5 ), followed by the benchmarking results ( Section 6 ).
Finally, we conclude in Section 7 .
blocks.zh:
本文件的其余部分如下:
我们首先将IMgMT列入相关工作(第2节)。 然后,我们介绍数据集(第3节),并介绍我们的评估协议(第4节)。 其次,我们详细介绍了我们的实验设置,以及我们如何使用ImgMT来制定技术、创新和技术方法的基准(第5节),然后是基准结果(第6节)。
最后,我们在第7节中结束发言。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Datasets for text-in-image translation
blocks.zh: 2.1 图像文本翻译数据集

blocks.en:
Existing datasets for TIT and IIMT vary widely in realism (synthetic vs. authentic), supervision (text-only vs. image-to-image), and domain.
Synthetic resources such as E2E_TIT_With_MT ( Ma et al., 2022 ) , the Multilingual IIMT dataset ( Lan et al., 2024 ) , IIMT30k ( Tian et al., 2025 ) , and VT-Syn ( Vaidya et al., 2025 ) scale by rendering parallel text onto background images, producing large corpora with controllable variation; their synthetic nature makes it straightforward to provide both source- and target-language texts and images.
blocks.zh:
TIT和IIMT的现有数据集在现实主义(合成对正性),监督(仅文本对成像),和域上差异很大.
E2E_TIT_With_MT(Ma等,2022年),多语言的IIMT数据集(Lan等,2024年),IIMT30k(Tian等,2025年),VT-Syn(Vaidya等,2025年)等合成资源通过将并行文本放入背景图像,产生具有可控变异性的大型蝎子;它们的合成性质使得既提供源语又提供目标语文本和图像变得直接.

blocks.en:
Authentic datasets instead curate real images with natural typography and visual clutter, typically relying on OCR and MT during construction. They often omit target-language images, which limits their direct applicability to IIMT and prevents evaluation in the reverse translation direction.
OCRMT30K ( Lan et al., 2023 ) , MTIT6 ( Qian et al., 2024 ) , and VT-Real ( Vaidya et al., 2025 ) collect human-translated scene text from multiple OCR datasets, with OCRMT30K and MTIT6 additionally providing bounding boxes. Although MTIT6 does not include target images, it supports IIMT evaluation by applying OCR to system-generated target images to recover the translated text.
blocks.zh:
真实的数据集用自然打字和视觉拼接来整理真实的图像,一般在构造过程中依靠OCR和MT. 它们经常省略目标语言图像,这限制了其直接适用于IIMT,并阻止了反向翻译方向的评价.
OCRMT30K(Lan等,2023年),MTIT6(Qian等,2024年),和VT-Real(Vaidya等,2025年)从多个OCR数据集收集人文翻译场景文本,由OCRMT30K和MTIT6额外提供捆绑盒. 虽然MTIT6不包括目标图像,但它通过将OCR应用于系统生成的目标图像来恢复被翻译的文本来支持IIMT评价.

blocks.en:
ECOIT ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) and MIT-10M ( Li et al., 2025 ) target e-commerce imagery crawled from the web, pairing OCR-extracted text with MT; ECOIT uses human post-editing, while MIT-10M applies a secondary MT system and embedding-based semantic similarity to filter likely translation errors.
Following a similar pipeline, IMTBench/IMT-1M ( Lyu et al., 2025 ) and MMTIT-Bench ( Li et al., 2026 ) combine scene images, web-crawled images, and document images.
DoTA ( Liang et al., 2024 ) focuses on document-page translation, using images of scientific-paper pages and providing outputs in Markdown.
blocks.zh:
ECOIT(Zhu等,2023年)和MIT-10M(Li等,2025年)的目标电子商务图像从网络上爬出,将OCR-提取出的案文与MT配对;ECOIT使用人后编辑,而MIT-10M则采用二级MT系统和嵌入式语义相似来过滤可能的翻译错误.
在经过类似的管道后,IMT Bench/IMT-1M(Lyu等,2025年)和MMTIT-Bench(Li等,2026年)结合了场景图像,网绘图像,以及文档图像.
DoTA (Liang等, 2024) 以文件页翻译为主,使用科学纸页的图像,并提供马克当语的产出.

blocks.en: Vectra-Bench ( Wu et al., 2026 ) is one of the few benchmarks with authentic source images that also provides target-language images (generated by vision–language models), enabling direct IIMT evaluation; it further emphasizes evaluation beyond text accuracy, including multilingual generalization and visual quality.
blocks.zh: Vectra-Bench(Wu等,2026年)是少数具有真实源图像的基准之一,也提供目标语言图像(由视觉-语言模型生成),能够直接进行IIMT评价;它进一步强调评价超出文本精度,包括多语种通化和视觉质量.

blocks.en: Most existing datasets cover only a small set of languages, with the broadest coverage (14–16 languages) reported by Li et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2026) . In addition, because target-side images are often missing, these datasets are generally unsuitable for reverse-direction translation.
blocks.zh: 大多数现有数据集只涵盖少量语言,最广泛的覆盖面由李等(2025;李等(2026)所报道. 此外,由于目标侧图像往往缺失,这些数据集一般不适合逆向翻译.

blocks.en: ImgMT differs from prior datasets along three axes. First, it targets vector-graphic diagrams, maps, and infographics rather than natural scene photos, e-commerce images, or document pages, shifting the challenge toward translating short, information-dense labels with specialized terminology and named entities. Second, it is built from Wikipedia SVG variants that preserve the underlying visual content while changing only the text, yielding aligned multilingual image pairs with consistent layouts and text positions, and directly supporting IIMT. Third, it substantially expands multilingual breadth: ImgMT spans 129 languages and over 20 writing systems, enabling evaluation across 4,886 language pairs in both directions and stress-testing multilingual and multi-script text-in-image translation beyond the coverage of prior benchmarks.
blocks.zh: ImgMT与前三轴相接的数据集不同. 首先,它针对矢量图、地图和图象,而不是自然场景相片、电子商务相片或文档页,将挑战转向使用专门术语和名称实体翻译简短、信息密集的标签。 二,由维基百科SVG变体所构建,既能保留了基本的视觉内容,又能只改变文字,产生有一致布局和文字位置的对齐多语种图像配对,并直接支持IIMT. 第三,它大幅度地扩大了多语种的广度: ImgMT跨越129个语言和20多个书写系统,使得能够对4 886个语言双向进行评价,并超越以往基准范围进行压力测试多语种和多语种成像翻译。

blocks.en: 2.2 Effect of Image in Multimodal Translation
blocks.zh: 2.2 图像在多式联运中的作用

blocks.en: The question of whether visual context improves translation quality has been studied extensively in the general MMT literature, most prominently in the context of the Multi30K dataset ( Elliott et al., 2016 ) and the associated WMT Multimodal Translation shared tasks ( Parida et al., 2024 ) . CoMMuTE ( Futeral et al., 2023 ) is an evaluation dataset for resolving textual ambiguity with visual context: 155 ambiguous English sentences, each paired with two images and two meaning-specific translations into French, German, and Czech by native speakers, with images sourced from Google Images or the authors.
blocks.zh: 视觉环境是否提高翻译质量的问题在一般的MMT文献中被广泛研究,最突出的是多30K数据集(Elliott等,2016年)和相关的WMT多式联运共享任务(Parida等,2024年). CoMMuTE(Futeral等,2023年)是一款用于用视觉上下文解决文字模糊性的评价数据集:155个模棱两可的英语句子,每句有两幅图像和两幅由母语人翻译为法语,德语和捷克语的特有含义翻译,图像取自Google图像或作者.

blocks.en: Early architectures such as multi-encoder, double-attention or gated fusion models reported only marginal improvements from incorporating image features over strong text-only baselines, and subsequent adversarial evaluations ( Elliott, 2018 ) showed that many multimodal systems are largely insensitive to the visual input, achieving similar scores even when paired with unrelated or shuffled images. Caglayan et al. (2019) revisited this question and found that visual grounding becomes useful mainly when the textual signal is degraded or ambiguous, rather than in standard, fully legible text conditions. More recently, Wu et al. (2021) argued that much of the previously reported benefit of visual context in prior work stemmed from erroneous evaluation protocols rather than from genuine multimodal grounding.
blocks.zh: 早期的建筑如多编码器,双意或有门的聚变模型,仅报告在强而只用文字的基线上融入了图像特征的微小改进,而后进行的对抗性评价(Elliott,2018)显示许多多模式系统对视觉输入基本不敏感,即使与无关或被打乱的图像对等,也取得了相近的分数. Caglayan等人(2019年)重新审视了这个问题,并发现视觉地平面主要是当文字信号退化或模糊时,而不是在标准,完全可辨认的文字条件下,才有用. 最近,Wu等人(2021年)认为,先前报告的视觉环境在前期工作中的好处大多出自错误的评价协议,而不是真正的多式联运基础。

blocks.en: Recent work with large vision-language models suggests that visual context is useful mainly when it resolves information that is missing or ambiguous in the text. DeDiT ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , for example, first detects textual ambiguity and then, optionally, uses the visual modality. Similarly, Yu et al. (2025) argue for adaptive fusion because images can help with ambiguity but may also introduce redundant or noisy information. Most recently, Guerra and Khrapunova (2026) show that the benefits of visual context are strongly task-dependent: relevant images help on CoMMuTE, but gains do not transfer consistently to other domains, including technical documentation with accompanying figures.
blocks.zh: 最近使用大型视觉语言模型的研究表明,视觉上下文主要在解决文本中缺失或模糊的信息时有用. DeDiT 软件 (Liu等,2025.) 例如:首先检测出文字模糊,然后可选择使用视觉模式. 同样, Yu等人(2025年)主张适应性聚变,因为图像可以帮助模糊,但也可能会引入冗余或吵闹的信息. 最近,Guerra和Khrapunova(2026年)表明,视觉环境的好处在很大程度上取决于任务:相关的图像有助于COMMuTE,但收益并没有一致地转移到其他领域,包括附带数字的技术文件。

blocks.en: This distinction is especially relevant for diagrams, maps, and infographics. Visual structure may be important for locating text, recovering reading order, or linking labels to graphical elements, but once the text is correctly extracted and semantically self-contained, the surrounding image may add little to the translation itself. We therefore expect visual context to matter mainly for ambiguous labels, abbreviations, or domain-specific terms whose meaning depends on the graphic, while having little effect on ordinary text. Section 6 tests this hypothesis directly.
blocks.zh: 这种区分对图表、地图和图表特别相关。 视觉结构对于查找文本,恢复读取顺序,或将标签与图形元素相连接可能很重要,但一旦文本被正确取出并自成一体,周围的图像可能对翻译本身增加不多. 因此,我们期望视觉上下文主要对于含义取决于图形的模糊的标签,缩写或域名特有名词很重要,而对于普通文本则影响不大. 第6节直接试验这一假设。

blocks.en: 3 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 数据集

blocks.en: The primary source of data for this project is Wikimedia Commons, 4 4 4 https://commons.wikimedia.org/ a repository of freely usable images and other multimedia content related to Wikipedia topics. Our objective was to create a multilingual dataset consisting of image pairs that differ only in their textual content, where texts at identical positions represent mutual translations.
blocks.zh: 这个项目的主要数据来源是Wikimedia Communications, 4 4 4 https://commons.wikimedia.org/ 自由使用图像和其他与维基百科主题相关的多媒体内容的存储库. 我们的目标是建立一个多语种数据集,由只有文字内容不同的图像对组成,其位置相同的文本代表相互翻译。

blocks.en: At the top level, the dataset is split into the directories train , dev and test . Within each split, files are organized into numbered folders representing image groups. Each group directory corresponds to one Wikimedia image with all its variants. 5 5 5 We prefer to talk about image groups rather than simply images because the image files belonging to the same group can and do differ. Conceptually, they should be the same image, differing at least in the text translation variant. It contains SVG source files, their PNG exports, and alignment annotations stored in JSON format. Each JSON file represents a directed translation pair between a source and a target language, 6 6 6 It can also be used for translation in the reverse direction. specifying image metadata, bounding box coordinates and aligned texts. For detailed overview of the repository directory and JSON schema, see Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 在顶层,数据集被分为目录列车,dev和测试. 在每次拆分中,文件被组织成代表图像组的编号文件夹. 每个组目录对应一个有其所有变体的维基媒体图像. 5 5 5 我们更喜欢谈论图像组,而不是单纯的图像,因为属于同一组的图像文件可以而且确实不同. 从概念上讲,它们应该是同一个图像,至少在文本翻译变体中有所不同。 它包含SVG源文件,他们的PNG导出,以及以JSON格式存储的对齐说明. 每个JSON文件代表一个源与目标语言之间的一对定向翻译对,6 6 6它也可以用于反向翻译. 指定图像元数据、边框坐标和对齐文本。 关于寄存器目录和JSON schema的详细概述,见附录A。

blocks.en: 3.1 Basic Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.1 基本统计

blocks.en: The dataset contains 35,612 aligned image pairs across 1,855 image groups (i.e., visually distinct images), comprising 235,637 text strings in total. The number of language variants per group ranges from 2 to 77, with an average of 4.95 variants per group.
blocks.zh: 该数据集包含35,612个对齐的图像对,跨越了1,855个图像组(即可视化鲜明的图像),共由235,637个文本字符串组成. 每组语言变种数量从2到77个不等,平均每组4.95个变种.

blocks.en: Overall the dataset includes 129 unique languages in over 20 writing systems (such as Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic, Devanagari, etc.; see more in Figure 1 ). Of 8,256 possible language pairs, 7 7 7 Corresponding to ( ( 129 2 ) {129\choose 2} ). the dataset includes 4,886 that can be used in both translation directions.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,数据集包括超过20个书写系统的129种独特的语言(如拉丁语、西里尔语、阿拉伯语、德瓦纳加里语等;见图一)。 在8,256种可能的语言配对中,7,7 7对应 (129 2) {129\choose 2}). 数据集包括4,886种,可以用于两个翻译方向.

blocks.en:
During the initial crawling (see Section 3.2 ), we collected raw URLs for all available image language variants in each group. Theoretically, taking any language as the source and any language as the target, this could lead up to 118k image pairs.
However, web-scraped SVG files are often noisy or unsuitable for our purpose. After applying our pipeline, the final dataset contains 35k pairs (about 30% of the theoretical maximum). The drop is intentional: many pairs could not be created because of issues in the SVG files, such as (1) invalid SVGs or SVGs with zero height or width, (2) font rendering errors, (3) failing the spatial overlap check, and (4) text saved as paths ( <path> ) instead of text elements ( <text> ) – unlike normal text elements, outlined paths do not store characters or words; they are saved only as drawing curves (shapes).
While we could use OCR to read these shapes, we decided not to do so to avoid introducing recognition errors into the gold ground-truth data.
blocks.zh:
在初始爬行过程中(见第3.2节),我们收集了每个组中所有可用图像语言变体的原始URL. 理论上,将任何语言作为源头,将任何语言作为目标,这可以导致高达118克的图像对.
然而,被网络搜索的SVG文件往往很吵或者不适合我们的目的. 在应用了我们的管道后,最终数据集包含35k对(约占理论最大值的30%). 投放是有意的:由于SVG文件中的问题,许多对无法创建,例如 (1) 无效的SVG 或 SVG 有零高度或宽度, (2) 字体渲染错误, (3) 未进行空间重叠检查, (4) 文本保存为路径(<path>) 而不是文本元素(<text>) – 与普通文本元素不同,被概括的路径不存储字符或词; 它们只保存为绘图曲线(形状).
虽然我们可以使用OCR来读取这些形状,但我们决定不这样做,以避免将识别错误引入黄金地-真实数据.

blocks.en: The dataset contains a wide variety of languages, but they are not evenly distributed. The most common languages are English (appearing in 5k image pairs across the entire dataset), Spanish (with 3.5k image pairs) and French (appearing in 3.3k pairs). In contrast, some languages are very rare, for example, Northern Sami language and Venetian language appear in only 4 pairs within the whole dataset. The complete distribution is detailed in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 数据集包含多种语言,但分布不均. 最常见的语言是英语(出现在整个数据集的5k图像对中),西班牙语(3.5k图像对中)和法语(出现在3.3k对中). 相形之下,一些语言非常罕见,例如北萨米语和威尼斯语在整个数据集中仅以4对出现. 完整分发情况详见附录B。

blocks.en: The test split is similar: 3,575 image pairs in total and 548 of them (15%) involve English. This allows us to reliably test translations to and from English while still keeping other diverse languages in the test set.
blocks.zh: 测试分法相似:总共3,575个图像对,其中548个(15%)涉及英语. 这使我们能够可靠地测试英文的译文,同时在测试集中保留其他多种语文。

blocks.en: Table 1: Distribution of string types (LLM-based categorization). Shares are computed over the consensus subset.
blocks.zh: 表1:字符串类型分布(基于LLM的分类). 份额是通过协商一致子集计算的。

blocks.en:
Because ImgMT consists primarily of diagrams, maps, and infographics, we expect most extracted strings to be short and rarely to form full sentences. Across all 235,637 strings, the average length is 9.29 characters.
To characterize the strings more deeply, we performed a multilingual analysis using an ensemble of three LLMs (Gemma 4, GPT-OSS-120B, Qwen3.8-27b). The models agreed on a label for 210,644 strings (89.4%; see Table 1 ), while the remaining 24,993 strings had no unanimous label.
Across the full set of strings, about 60% are proper names, about 33–38% are common noun phrases, and 1–3% are statements without a finite verb; well-formed sentences account for only about 0.5%.
Overall, this distribution indicates that ImgMT is dominated by short, label-like text, with a high share of proper names rather than sentence-level discourse.
blocks.zh:
由于 ImgMT 主要由图,地图,和图等组成,我们预计所提取的字符串大多会很短而很少形成完整的句子. 在所有235 637个字符串中,平均长度为9.29个字符.
为了更深刻地描述这些字符串,我们使用由三个LLMs(Gemma 4,GPT-OSS-120B,Qune3.8-27b)组成的组合进行了多语种分析. 模型商定了210,644个字符串的标签(89.4%;见表1),而其余24,993个字符串没有一致的标签.
在整个系列字符串中,大约60%是正名,大约33-38%是常用名词短语,1-3%是没有限定动词的语句;完善的句子仅占约0.5%.
总的来说,这种分布表明ImgMT以短,标签相近的文字为主,在正名中占有很高的份额,而不是句子层次的论述.

blocks.en: 3.2 Processing Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 处理管道

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , the pipeline consists of the four following steps: (1) data collection, (2) filtering and grouping, (3) extraction and pairing and (4) dataset splitting.
blocks.zh: 如图3所示,管道包括以下四个步骤:(1) 数据收集,(2) 过滤和分组,(3) 取出和配对,(4) 数据集分拆。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Pipeline overview for generating the multilingual ImgMT dataset
blocks.zh: 图3:生成多语种IMGMT数据集的管道概览

blocks.en: In this stage, raw multimodal data is sourced from Wikimedia Commons. We primarily crawl files from the category Translation_possible_-_SVG , 8 8 8 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Translation_possible_-_SVG which is a rich source of multilingual diagrams, maps, graphs etc. Additionally, we extract explicitly linked language variants by parsing the Other versions templates often found on file description pages. This combined approach allows us to get a large initial pool of potential image translations.
blocks.zh: 在这一阶段,原始多式数据来源于维基媒体共同公司. 我们主要从"翻译-可能"(Context_possible_--SVG)类别来爬取文件,8 8 8 8 https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/ Category: Translation_possible_--SVG 这是多种语言图、地图、图表等的丰富来源。 此外,我们通过解析文件描述页上经常发现的其他版本模板来提取明确链接的语言变体. 这种综合方法使我们能够获得大量初步的潜在图像翻译。

blocks.en:
The crawled data goes through a filtering process. Non-SVG formats or SVG files which cannot be parsed and images that render with zero width or height are immediately discarded. Then we parse the file descriptions to extract valid language codes using a custom heuristic mapped to ISO language codes. While images from the Translation_possible_-_SVG category often label their variants by language, this is not always the case (some labels describe file types or visual changes rather than languages).
Next, to accurately group the translated variants, we evaluate visual similarity across the images. Candidate files found within the same translation table on the image Wikimedia page are grouped together only if their visual layout is similar, evaluated using the Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) ( Wang et al., 2004 ) .
If a visually consistent cluster contains two or more valid language variants, we keep it as a separate group.
blocks.zh:
所爬行的数据通过过滤过程. 无法被解析的非 SVG 格式或 SVG 文件, 并且以零宽度或高度渲染的图像立即被丢弃 。 然后我们解析文件描述,以提取有效的语言代码,使用自定义的heuristic映射到ISO语言代码. 翻译中的图像_ 可能_ _ SVG 分类往往用语言来标记它们的变体,但情况并非总是如此(有些标签描述的是文件类型或视觉变化,而不是语言)。
其次,为了精确地将被翻译的变体分组,我们评价了图像之间的视觉相似性. 图片维基媒体页面上在同一翻译表格中找到的候选文件,只有在其视觉布局相近时才进行分组,使用结构相似性指数度量(SSIM)进行评审(Wang等人,2004年).
如果一个视觉上一致的集群包含两个或多个有效的语言变体,我们把它作为一个单独的组保存.

blocks.en:
To accurately extract textual elements and their spatial coordinates, we utilize Inkscape ( Inkscape Project, 2023 ) which renders the SVGs to provide precise absolute bounding boxes. The extracted text elements are then paired across languages using three prioritized strategies.
First, if the SVG file contains <switch> elements, texts are paired purely based on predefined systemLanguage tags (the svg_switch method).
Second, if standard switches are absent, the pipeline attempts to align texts using structural identifiers (eg. tspanID or textID ; the svg_id_match strategy).
However, as internal IDs are frequently mismatched, missing or incomplete across translated images, we mostly rely on the third method: spatial overlap, which pairs text elements based on their intersection over union (IoU score). The image pairs are then categorized as unambiguous (strict 1:1 match between the boxes with zero unmapped ones; denoted unamb_spatial_overlap ) and ambiguous mapping (the rest; labeled amb_spatial_overlap ). Table 2 reports detailed statistics on the number of image pairs obtained by each alignment method in the cascade.
Finally, the image dimensions and corresponding bounding boxes are normalized: we identify the minimum font size within an image group and proportionally scale the image dimensions and spatial coordinates by a calculated ratio, ensuring that the smallest text remains clearly legible.
blocks.zh:
为了精确地提取出文字元素及其空间坐标,我们利用了Inkscape(Inkscape Project,2023)使得SVGs提供精确的绝对边框. 然后,通过三种优先战略,将所提取的文本要素在各种语言之间配对。
首先,如果 SVG 文件包含"switch" 元素, 文本完全根据预定义的系统对齐 语言标记(svg_switch方法).
第二,如果没有标准开关,管道试图使用结构标识符(如tspanID或textID; svg_id_match 策略)来对齐文本.
然而,作为内部 ID在被翻译的图像中经常不匹配,缺失或不完整,我们主要依靠第三种方法: 空间重叠,即根据相交点而将文本元素相接于结合(IoU分数). 然后将图像对分为毫不含糊的(框与零未映射的框相接的1:1;表示unamb_spatial_overlap)和模棱两可的映射(其余;标注为hamb_spatial_overlap.). 表2详细统计了级联中每种对齐方法获得的图像对的数量。
最后,图像尺寸和相应的边框都实现了正常化:我们在一个图像组内识别出最小的字体大小,并用一个计算出的比例来按比例地标出图像尺寸和空间坐标,确保最小的文本保持清晰可辨.

blocks.en: Table 2: Success of text alignment methods across dataset splits. The methods are carried out in the specified order and an image pair is counted with the method which succeeds first.
blocks.zh: 表2: 各数据集分拆的文本对接方法成功. 方法按照指定的顺序进行,并用首先成功的方法计算出一对图像。

blocks.en: In the final stage, the processed data is distributed into train , dev and test sets using an 80:10:10 ratio. 9 9 9 Due to the leakage-prevention clustering constraint, the resulting dev and test splits each comprise slightly more than 10% of the total data. Importantly, this stage implements a data leakage prevention mechanism. Image groups that share identical visual content but differ slightly in layout or metadata — such as a standard historical map versus a visually impaired version, which might have been initially parsed as a separate groups — are identified and put into the same dataset split. This constraint guarantees that no language variant or minor visual modification of a specific image seen during training can appear in the development or test sets. The splitting algorithm also balances the distribution of the three alignment methods across all sets, as detailed in Table 2 . However, to strictly prevent cross-split visual leakage, we did not enforce explicit balancing of individual languages or writing systems across the sets.
blocks.zh: 在最后阶段,处理后的数据被分配到列车,dev和测试集中,使用80:10:10的比例. 9.9 由于防止渗漏的集群限制,由此产生的脱层和测试分拆分别占总数据的10%略多。 重要的是,这一阶段实施了一个数据泄漏预防机制。 图像组具有相同的视觉内容,但在布局或元数据方面略有不同,例如标准历史地图与视觉受损版本,这些版本最初可能被解析为一个单独的组,它们被确定并放入同一数据集分出. 这种限制保证,在开发或测试集中不能出现语言变体或对培训期间看到的具体图像的微小视觉修改。 如表2所详述,分割算法还平衡了三种对齐方法在所有各套中的分布。 然而,为了严格防止相片相片相片相片的视觉外溢,我们并没有对各套语言或写作系统实施明确的平衡.

blocks.en: To convert the processed SVG files into raster PNG images, we use Inkscape via command-line interface. To maintain identical resolution and scale across all language variants within a single group, the target export height is extracted from the alignment JSON metadata (which was pre-calculated based on the smallest font size, as described above) and passed to Inkscape using the --export-height flag.
blocks.zh: 要将已处理的SVG文件转换为光栅PNG图像,我们通过命令行接口使用Inkscape. 为了在单个组内的所有语言变体中保持相同的分辨率和尺度,目标导出高度取自对齐的JSON元数据(如上所描述的,根据最小字体大小预先计算)并使用-export-height旗传递给Inkscape.

blocks.en: 3.3 Manual Evaluation of the Dataset Collection Method
blocks.zh: 3.3 数据集收集方法的人工评估

blocks.en: The dataset construction pipeline comprises multiple stages, each of which can introduce errors. For example, paired images can diverge beyond acceptable text differences, some text may be missed when it is encoded as vector paths rather than text objects, and our position-based heuristics can fail. To quantify the impact of these issues, we compare the automatically collected dataset against manual annotations.
blocks.zh: 数据集建设管线由多个阶段组成,每个阶段都可以引入出错. 例如,配对的图像可以相差超过可接受的文本差异,一些文本被编码为向量路径而不是文本对象时可能会被忽略,而我们基于位置的heuristics可能失败. 为了量化这些问题的影响,我们将自动收集的数据集与人工说明进行比较。

blocks.en: We randomly sample 100 image pairs from the test set and annotate them using a purpose-built tool implemented for this study (a screenshot is shown in Appendix C ). 10 10 10 Due to a display bug affecting SVGs paired using the svg_switch method, we had to omit 10 such examples from the evaluation. Since this alignment method is, by design, the most precise, this omission should not negatively affect the reported statistics. First, annotators judge whether the images in the pair are identical (still regardless the texts). They may decide to skip an example if they consider the images too different. Second, annotators manually correct the bounding boxes and their cross-image correspondences. All bounding-box edits are permitted (addition, deletion, and resizing). Annotators do not edit the text content associated with each box, as this is often impractical, particularly when the text uses an unfamiliar script. Finally, the annotators correct the cross-lingual correspondences. These are required to be one-to-one, which may require splitting or merging bounding boxes. In addition to visual cues, annotators can use automatic English translations of the extracted text fields provided by the annotation tool. Two annotators split the batch evenly, each correcting half of the pairs.
blocks.zh: 我们从测试集中随机抽取出100个图像对,并使用为本研究设计的专用工具进行注释(截图载于附录C). 10 10 由于一个显示错误影响到使用 svg_switch 方法对映的 SVG,我们不得不在评价中省略了10个这样的例子. 由于这种调整方法在设计上是最精确的,因此这一省略不应对所报告的统计数据产生不利影响。 首先,注释者判断配对中的图像是否相同(不管文本如何). 如果它们认为图像过于不同,它们可能决定跳过一个例子。 二,注释员手动校正边框及其交叉相像函. 允许所有边框编辑(添加、删除和再大小)。 注释者不编辑与每个框相关的文本内容,因为这往往不切实际,特别是当文本使用不熟悉的脚本时. 最后,注释者纠正了交叉语言的函文. 要求它们为一对一,这可能需要拆分或合并捆绑箱. 除可视提示外,注释器还可以使用由注释工具提供的被提取文本字段的自动英语翻译. 两名注释员将批次平分,每人改正一半的对.

blocks.en:
In 13% cases the paired images were too different for text-in-image translation evaluation.
In 16% cases the images were identical except for minor graphical differences. These images are usable for IIMT with a grain of salt but they are perfectly suitable for TIT evaluation.
The remaining pairs of images were visually completely identical.
blocks.zh:
在13%的案例中,配对图像对于文本成像翻译评价来说太不同了。
在16%的案例中,图像是相同的,但图象上的细微差异除外。 这些图像可用于含一粒盐的IIMT,但完全适合TIT评价.
其余的一对图像在视觉上完全相同。

blocks.en: We measure bounding-box localization accuracy with two precision/recall metrics that quantify alignment between the manually annotated boxes and those in the original data. Bounding Box Count (BBC) measures agreement in the number of boxes, while Bounding Box Area (BBA) measures agreement by the area of overlap between boxes.
blocks.zh: 我们用两个精确/召回的度量标准来衡量边框本地化的准确性,这些度量标准将手动附加说明的框和原始数据中的框之间的校正量化。 Bonding Box Counter(BBC)按箱数计量协议,而Bonding Box Area(BBA)按箱数重叠区域计量协议.

blocks.en: Table 3 reports bounding-box quality for all boxes (text-field detection), matched boxes (a one-to-one match exists across the pair), and correctly matched boxes (the match is the correct cross-lingual correspondence).
blocks.zh: 表3报告所有框的绑定框质量(文本-字段检测),相匹配框(一对对对存在一对匹配),正确匹配框(相匹配是正确的跨语言对应).

blocks.en:
After all steps, BBA precision remains above 91%, while recall is around 83%; most of the gap is due to text-field detection.
BBC exhibits similar performance.
Although this recall drop should not affect comparing multiple systems on the same dataset, it should be considered when interpreting the absolute results.
blocks.zh:
经过所有步骤后,BBA精度仍然高于91%,而回想大约为83%;大部分缺口是由于文本字段检测.
BBC展出类似演出.
虽然这种召回下降不应影响在同一数据集上比较多个系统,但在解释绝对结果时应考虑到这一点。

blocks.en: Table 3: Manual evaluation of dataset quality. Rows correspond to (i) all detected text-field boxes ( All boxes ), (ii) boxes for which a one-to-one cross-image correspondence exists ( Matched boxes ), and (iii) boxes whose correspondence is the correct cross-lingual match ( Correctly matched ). Columns report precision/recall/F1 for box count (BBC) and area overlap (BBA).
blocks.zh: 表3:对数据集质量的人工评价。 行对应 (一)所有被检测到的文本字段相框(所有相框), (二)存在一对一相框相框的相框(匹配相框), (三)其相框为正确相框相框的相框(正确匹配相框). 各栏报告精确/召回/F1的箱数(BBC)和面积重叠(BBA)。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation Method
blocks.zh: 4. 评价方法

blocks.en: In our work, we focus on evaluating Text-in-Image Translation (TIT). As shown in Figure 2 , our evaluation system compares gold reference data with model predictions (machine output).
blocks.zh: 在我们的工作中,我们侧重于评价图像文本翻译。 如图2所示,我们的评价系统将黄金参考数据与模型预测(机器输出)进行比较。

blocks.en: The first phase evaluates the model’s ability to accurately detect and read text from the source image. We compare the extracted predicted text with the source gold text using the Character Error Rate (CER) .
blocks.zh: 第一阶段评价了模型准确检测和从源图像读取文本的能力. 我们使用字符错误率(CER)将所提取的预测文本与源黄金文本进行比较。

blocks.en:
If predicted bounding boxes are available – which may not be the case for models that only output raw text – we use them to pair the predicted texts with the reference texts. At the same time, we evaluate the bounding boxes localization accuracy by two metrics already introduced in Section 3.3 : (1) BBA ( Bounding Box Area ), which measures spatial overlap by calculating the harmonic mean of area-based precision and recall across intersecting bounding boxes, and (2) BBC ( Bounding Box Count ), which measures discrete block-level retrieval based on paired True Positives.
If not stated otherwise, we mean the F1 score by referring to these measures.
blocks.zh:
如果有预想的边框可供使用 — — 对于只输出原始文本的模型来说可能不是这样 — — 我们用它们来将预想的文本与参考文本配对。 同时,我们用第3.3节中已经引入的两种度量标准来评价边框本地化精度:(1) BBBA(边框区),它通过计算以地区为基础的精确度和跨相交边框的回溯的谐波平均值来测量空间重叠;(2) BBC(边框计数),它根据配对的"真正"测量离散的块级检索.
如果不另作说明,我们指这些措施的F1分。

blocks.en: To handle cases where an OCR model splits a single line or paragraph into multiple smaller boxes, we use a text merging mechanism. If several predicted boxes overlap with the same reference box, we sort their text horizontally from left to right and join it into one string. We also merge their coordinates into a single bounding box before calculating the CER and BBA metrics.
blocks.zh: 为了处理一个OCR模型将一行或一款分割成多个更小的框的情况,我们使用文本合并机制. 如果数个预测的框与同一个参考框相重叠,我们就将它们的文本从左到右横向排序,并合并为一个字符串。 在计算CER和BBA指标之前,我们还将它们的坐标合并为单一的边框.

blocks.en: The second phase measures the quality of translated text. We evaluate the output using a traditional lexical metric chrF ( Popović, 2015 ) and an advanced semantic metric COMET , specifically the wmt22-comet-da model ( Rei et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 第二阶段衡量翻译文本的质量。 我们使用传统的语法计量chrF(Popović, 2015年)和先进的语义计量COMET, 特别是wmt22-comet-da模型(Rei等, 2022年)来评价产出。

blocks.en: In scenarios where the prediction does not provide bounding box coordinates, the system aligns text blocks using the Hungarian algorithm for matching in bipartite graphs. Alignment is driven by a composite cost matrix combining text dissimilarity with a spatial reading-order penalty. Dissimilarity is calculated using CER for OCR or inverted quality score (one minus the metric score) for translation evaluation via chrF or COMET, with low-quality candidate pairs filtered out by task-specific thresholds. To maintain spatial consistency, we add a position penalty calculated as the absolute difference between the relative positions of predicted and reference texts, assuming a top-to-bottom, left-to-right reading order. The algorithm then selects one-to-one pairs that minimize the total cost and rejects any pairs that exceed the threshold.
blocks.zh: 在预测不提供边框坐标的情景下,系统使用匈牙利算法来对齐双相图中的文本块. 校正由综合成本矩阵驱动,将文本差异与空间读取顺序处罚相结合。 Dissimility是通过ChrF或COMET进行翻译评价时,使用CER进行OCR或倒数质量分数(一减一分)来计算,低质量的候选配对通过任务特定阈值过滤出. 为了保持空间一致性,我们增加一个位置罚分,计算为预测文本和参考文本相对位置的绝对差,假设从上到下,从左到右的读取顺序. 算法然后选择一对一来将总成本最小化并拒绝任何超过阈值的对.

blocks.en: 5 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 实验设置

blocks.en:
To demonstrate the practical utility of the proposed framework, we evaluate several multimodal systems on both the TIT and MMT tasks. All experiments are conducted on the dataset’s test split.
For TIT, we use the PNG versions of the images at their native resolution as the input, without any additional preprocessing or visual transformations.
blocks.zh:
为了证明拟议框架的实际效用,我们评价了几个多式联运系统,既涉及技术性投资协定,也涉及多式联运协定。 所有实验都是在数据集的测试分解上进行的.
对于TIT来说,我们使用PNG版本的原生分辨率的图像作为输入,没有额外的预处理或视觉转换.

blocks.en: The first experiment evaluates the performance of several multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and one dedicated pipelined system on the TIT task with English as the source language.
blocks.zh: 第一次实验评价了几种多模式大型语言模型(MLLMs)和一个以英语为源语言的TIT任务专用管道系统的表现.

blocks.en: The evaluated MLLMs are Qwen3.5 (MoE of 122B parameters, 10B active), Claude Haiku 4.5 , Kimi K3 (MoE of 2.8T parameters, 104B active), and GPT-5.6 Luna . To ensure a fair comparison, all models are evaluated using the same zero-shot prompt. The prompt instructs the model to detect all text present in the bitmap image, estimate the corresponding source text bounding boxes, transcribe the detected text, and translate it into the target language. The expected output consists of a structured representation containing the predicted source text bounding boxes, the recognized source texts, and the translated target texts.
blocks.zh: 被评价的MLLMs有:Quen3.5 (122B参数的MoE,10B活性),克洛德·海库 4.5 (Claude Haiku 4.5),克米克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克克 为确保公平比较,所有模型都使用同样的零射速率来评价. 即时指示模型检测位图图像中的所有文本,估计相应的源文本绑定框,将被检测到的文本转录,并翻译成目标语言. 预期产出包括结构化的表述,包括预测的源文本捆绑框,公认的源文本和被翻译的目标文本.

blocks.en: We also evaluate AnyTrans ( Qian et al., 2024 ) , a pipelined IIMT system that we slightly adapt to our benchmark. While AnyTrans can render translations back into the image, we do not use this capability in our TIT experiments. Given an input image and the source and target languages, the system performs translation in three stages. First, an OCR engine detects and recognizes the text in the image, producing transcriptions together with their bounding boxes. Our adaptation supports multiple OCR backends; in the experiments reported here, we use PaddleOCR ( Cui et al., 2025 ) only. The recognized text is then passed to a large language model for translation; we use DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Thinking . Finally, in the rendering stage (not used in our TIT setup), the original text regions are removed and replaced with the translated text using the detected bounding boxes.
blocks.zh: 我们还评价了AnyTrans(Qian等,2024年),这是一个我们稍作调整以适应基准的管道式IIMT系统. 虽然AnyTrans可以将翻译重新翻译成图像,但我们在TIT实验中并没有使用这种能力. 鉴于输入图像以及来源和目标语言,该系统分三个阶段进行翻译。 首先,一个OCR引擎在图像中检测并识别出文字,产生抄本连同其边框. 我们的适应支持多个OCR后端;在本文所报道的实验中,我们只使用PaddleOCR(Cui等,2025年). 然后,公认的文本被传递给一个大语言模型进行翻译;我们使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Thinking. 最后,在渲染阶段(我们TIT设置中没有使用),将原始文本区域去除并被取而代之的是使用被检测到的边框来翻译的文本.

blocks.en: In these experiments, an image is scored only when the model returns a well-formed output that matches the required structured format. If the model fails to produce a valid result, that image is skipped and excluded from all metrics. Reported scores therefore reflect performance on the subset of English-source test images with valid model outputs, not on the full test set.
blocks.zh: 在这些实验中,一个图像只有在模型返回一个与所要求结构格式相匹配的成型良好的输出时才会被打分. 如果模型不能产生有效结果,则该图像会被跳过,并被排除在所有衡量标准之外。 因此,报告得分反映的是具有有效模型输出的英语源测试图像子集的性能,而不是完整的测试集.

blocks.en: The second experiment aims to test the influence of writing systems on TIT performance. It evaluates GPT-5.6 Luna on language pairs with English as the target language, allowing for comparison of translation quality across different source scripts. GPT-5.6 Luna is selected for this experiment because it combines relatively strong overall performance with a low rate of invalid outputs as demonstrated in the previous experiment, resulting in a more complete and reliable evaluation across the diverse set of source languages. Results are reported separately for each script group using the same OCR and translation metrics.
blocks.zh: 第二个实验旨在测试写作系统对TIT性能的影响. 它评价了以英语为目标语言的语言对等的GPT-5.6 Luna,从而可以比较不同源脚本的翻译质量. GPT-5.6 Luna被选入本次实验,因为它结合了相对强大的整体性能和前一次实验所显示的低效输出率,从而在多种源语言中产生了更完整更可靠的评价. 每个脚本组采用相同的OCR和翻译指标分别报告结果。

blocks.en:
To isolate the contribution of visual context in our MMT analysis (beyond translating the extracted text alone) we compare three input conditions on the English-source test set.
Because this experiment targets MMT, we evaluate only the four MLLMs and exclude AnyTrans.
The extracted source text—pulled directly from the SVGs (i.e., without OCR)—is held constant across conditions: (1) Image , where the fully rendered source image is provided alongside the text input; (2) Text-only image , where we render the same image after removing all non-text graphical elements (e.g., backgrounds, icons, shapes) and retaining only the black text layer, preserving line breaks and spatial layout but discarding graphical content (see Section 3.2 ); and (3) No image , where the model receives only the extracted source text segments with no visual input.
blocks.zh:
为了在我们的MMT分析中孤立视觉上下文的贡献(超越仅翻译取出的案文),我们比较了英-源测试集的三个输入条件.
因为这次实验针对的是MMT,所以我们只评估了四个MLLM,排除了Any Trans.
直接取自SVGs(即没有OCR)的取出源文本在条件上保持不变:(1)图像,完全渲染出源图像与文本输入同时提供;(2)只取出文本的图像,在删除了所有非文本图形元素(如背景,图标,形状)并仅保留了黑色文本层后,保留了行断和空间布局,但丢弃了图形内容(见第3.2节);(3)没有图像,模型只接收取出源文本片段而无视觉输入.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 6 实验和结果

blocks.en:
Table 4 reports end-to-end TIT scores for all evaluated systems, covering translation quality, OCR accuracy, and bounding-box localization.
Kimi K3 performs best overall, achieving the highest chrF (61.3) and COMET (0.834). GPT-5.6 Luna attains slightly higher localization scores (BBA and BBC) while delivering comparable translation quality. Claude Haiku 4.5 lags behind on all metrics, with a CER of 0.822 and markedly lower translation and localization scores.
blocks.zh:
表4报告所有被评价系统的端到端TIT分数,涵盖翻译质量、OCR准确度和边框本地化。
Kimi K3总体表现最佳,达到最高的ChrF(61.3)和COMET(0.834)。 GPT-5.6 Luna的本地化分数略高(BBA和BBC),同时提供相仿的翻译质量. Claude Haiku 4.5在所有度量衡上落后,CER为0.822,翻译和本地化得分明显较低.

blocks.en: Qwen3.5 shows worse OCR quality and text localization, but almost the same translation quality. This suggests that end-to-end translation quality is not determined solely by exact source-side transcription and bounding-box prediction. Nevertheless, the large performance gap of Claude Haiku 4.5 across both source- and target-side metrics indicates that errors in text detection and recognition can become a major bottleneck when sufficiently severe. This is further evidenced by results on the gold source texts extracted from the SVGs in Table 6 – Claude has a similar translation performance to the other three models in that setting.
blocks.zh: Quen3.5显示了更糟糕的OCR质量和文本本地化,但翻译质量几乎相同. 这表明端到端的翻译质量并非完全由准确的源侧转录和边框预测所决定. 尽管如此,Claude Haiku 4.5在源面和目标面的衡量尺度上都存在很大的性能差距,这表明文本检测和识别方面的错误如果足够严重,就可能成为一大瓶颈。 从表6中从SVG中取出黄金来源文本的结果进一步证明了这一点——克劳德的翻译性能与当时的其他三种模型类似。

blocks.en: The AnyTrans pipeline achieves the lowest CER (0.161) and competitive localization. Its translation quality is slightly lower than Kimi K3, Qwen3.5, and GPT-5.6 Luna, though it remains well above Claude Haiku 4.5.

Arabic further illustrates that the metrics do not necessarily move together: it exhibits better CER but worse localization and downstream translation, so accurate transcription alone is not sufficient. Overall, OCR accuracy, localization accuracy, and translation quality are only weakly coupled across scripts; results for very small groups should be interpreted cautiously.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,Dravidiian和Bengladi-Assamese在大多数衡量标准上都退化了,表明这些脚本在抄写和翻译上仍然具有挑战性。 阿拉伯语进一步说明,衡量标准不一定一致:它显示的CER更好,但本地化和下游翻译更差,因此光是准确的抄录是不够的。 总体而言,OCR的准确性,本地化的准确性,以及翻译质量在不同的脚本之间只有微弱的结合;对于极小组的结果,应该谨慎地解释.

As apparent from the table, differences across conditions are small. Overall, providing the image does not materially change performance: either the extracted texts are already unambiguous, or these models are not reliably using the visual signal for disambiguation.

blocks.en: Overall, these results run counter to our hypothesis in Section 2.2 : conditioning on the source image is neutral-to-harmful for chrF across all four models. This may reflect competition for attention/context budget or OCR/reading errors from visual clutter; since infographic text is typically unambiguous, images offer little disambiguation benefit. We conclude that adding the source image is not a reliable way to improve translation quality on this benchmark.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果与我们在第2.2节中的假设相违背:对源图像的调节对chr是中和到有害的. F横穿了所有四个模型. 这可能反映出人们对注意力/文字预算或OCR/读取视觉杂乱的误差的竞争;由于图象文字一般是清晰的,图象几乎不会带来混淆不清的好处。 我们的结论是,增加源图像不是在这个基准上提高翻译质量的可靠方式。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduced ImgMT , a massively multilingual dataset for evaluating text-in-image translation (image-only inputs), such as Text Image Translation (text-only output).
We also proposed a multi-level evaluation protocol that combines complementary metrics at different granularities.
We demonstrated the framework on several MLLMs and one dedicated system in both English → \to X and X → \to English settings, showing that the source language and writing system matter for TIT quality.
Finally, we used ImgMT to probe the role of visual context in multimodal translation (text+image input). In our setup, adding the source image yields little benefit over text-only inputs and can even degrade performance, suggesting that ImgMT is not well suited for isolating the contribution of visual information in MMT.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们引入了ImgMT(英语:ImgMT (text-ext-ext)),这是一个大规模多语言的数据集,用于评价图像中文本翻译(仅图像输入),例如文本图像翻译(仅文本输出).
我们还提出了一个多层次的评价议定书,将不同颗粒体的补充性衡量标准结合起来。
我们示范了几个MLLM和一个英语-\to X和X-的专用系统,显示源语言和写作系统对TIT质量很重要。
最后,我们利用ImgMT来探究视觉上下文在多模式翻译中的作用(文本+图像输入). 在我们的设置中,添加源图像对文本输入没有什么好处,甚至可以降低性能,这表明IMgMT不适合隔离MMT中视觉信息的贡献.

blocks.en: Our experiments focused mainly on TIT; however, ImgMT can also be used to benchmark In-image Machine Translation (image-only output), which we leave for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验主要集中于TIT;然而,ImgMT也可以被用来为In-image Machine Conference(仅以图像为主的输出)设定基准,我们离开它去做今后的工作.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The dataset is derived from Wikimedia Commons SVGs, which introduces limitations for both data quality and evaluation. First, the annotations do not capture all text present in the source images. To reduce noise, we extract only text represented as SVG text spans and do not apply OCR; as a result, text rendered as vector paths is missing. Moreover, we rely on Inkscape’s spatial query tool, which requires text elements to have explicit id attributes; elements without an id (or embedded in complex paths/groups) cannot be queried for exact bounding boxes and are omitted to avoid alignment errors. These choices may bias evaluation (e.g., by overestimating recall). Second, the language-pair distribution is imbalanced: because the source images come from Wikimedia Commons, high-resource languages (e.g., English, Spanish, French, German, and Russian) dominate, while some low-resource or regional languages occur in fewer than 10 pairs. Finally, because ImgMT is built from publicly available Wikimedia data, there is a risk of data contamination: some tested MLLMs may have encountered parts of the benchmark during pre-training.
blocks.zh: 该数据集出自Wikimedia Communitys SVGs,该数据集对数据质量和评价都提出了限制. 首先,注释没有包含源图像中的所有文本. 为了减少噪音,我们只提取以 SVG 文本跨度表示的文本,而不应用 OCR;因此,缺少作为向量路径提供文本 。 此外,我们依赖Inkscape的空间查询工具,它要求文本元素具有明确的id属性;没有id(或嵌入于复杂的路径/组)的元素不能被询问精确的绑定框并被省略以避免对齐错误. 这些选择可能偏向评价(如高估召回)。 其次,语言-pair分布不平衡:因为源头图像出自维基媒体通俗(Wikimedia Communications),高资源语言(如英语,西班牙语,法语,德语和俄语)占主导地位,而有的低资源或地区语言出现于不到10对. 最后,由于ImgMT是用公开的维基媒体数据构建的,因此存在数据被污染的风险:一些经过测试的MLLMM可能在预训期间遇到了部分基准.

blocks.en: Due to budget and computational constraints, we restricted our evaluation to translation directions that include English (English → \to X and X → \to English) in a zero-shot setting, and we evaluated only the test split. This means our results cover only a subset of the available benchmark pairs; the remaining roughly 30,000 pairs in the training and development splits were prepared primarily to enable future training or fine-tuning studies, but we did not evaluate all bidirectional pairs across the full dataset in this paper. In addition, while ImgMT is suitable for evaluating text-in-image translation approaches beyond TIT, including IIMT (image-only output), we did not benchmark the IIMT setup here.
blocks.zh: 由于预算和计算方面的限制,我们的评价仅限于在零镜头设置中包括英语(英语 →\to X和X →\to English)的翻译方向,我们只评价了测试分. 这意味着我们的结果只涵盖现有基准对的子集;在培训和开发分拆中剩下的大约30,000对主要是为了将来的培训或微调研究而准备的,但我们没有评价本文件中整个数据集的所有双向对。 此外,虽然ImgMT适合评价TIT之外的文本入映翻译方法,包括IIMT(仅以图像输出),但我们并没有将IIMT设置作为这里的基准.
